integrity: New analysis includes a complete analytic proof, a finite exact-arithmetic checker, and bibliographic comparisons with explicit residual risk. No external mathematical audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for finite real nonnegative column-stochastic matrices with a fixed common nonnegative row minorant summing to less than one, in the induced l1 norm; it does not bound inverse norm alone or classify all equality matrices.
title: Sharp Doeblin-minorized adjugate norm for finite Markov operators
